main_text.p: pune dici ac fieri possit. Quali non æque rationis participes sit, qui obscuris, quam qui præ-claris ortus est parentibus. Et non cuique mortalium, injuriarum sensu affecto, eadem & par concessa facultas adversus injurias illatas semet tuendi, vel eas ferendo, vel etiam inferendo. Quid hoc aliud est, quam Deo diffidere velle, penes quem vindictæ judicium, & executio, quasi non justus omnium injuriarum sit vindex, nec æque sit vindicaturus illatam forte nobilibus injuriam, quam factam plebeis. Ut iniquus sit in Deum, qui vindicem gladium tantum magistratibus concreditum, illi eripit, sibique hoc attribuit, quod inferioris sortis homini denegatum statuit. Non ita certe fieri oportuit. Neque enim, quæ Deus in aliquem contulit beneficia, nobilitatem honorem

page.notes: The bullet marks beside the second line ("non æque") and at the right of the text block are printed marks or specks, not text, so they are left out. Small faint marks at the right edge and the faint text in the bottom right corner are scan artefacts or digitiser marks, not printed text. "diffidere" and "præ-" are read from a slightly blurred scan; the letters are probably right but may need checking.
